datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mauritania in 2013. Geographic boundaries and food insecurity phase classifications were compiled into multi-temporal GeoJSON and KML formats representing medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions.
